description: Display frame recording information in a compact format optimized for MCP tools. Shows frame metadata, console logs, and timestamps without including large image data. If the session is absent AND this server holds a stale database file, it fails with that reason instead of reporting a plain not-found, which would describe this process rather than your data.

logLevel.description: Filter logs by level: error, warn, info, debug, log, or all (default: all)

maxFrames.description: Maximum number of frames to display (default: 10)

maxLogsPerFrame.description: Maximum number of logs to show per frame (default: 10). Use 0 for no limit.

sessionId.description: The frame session ID to display

showInteractions.description: Whether to show user interactions for each frame (default: true)

showLogs.description: Whether to show console logs for each frame (default: true)

name: chromedebug_show_frames
